author: NIN Creative Studio
title: Hiring Illustrator Artists - All Levels
content: 🎨 NIN Creative Studio is Hiring! Are you passionate about Illustration and ready to turn creative ideas into compelling artwork? NIN Creative Studio is looking for Illustrator Artists – All Levels to join us on a variety of creative projects, from Characters and Creatures to Environments, Fantasy, and Game Art. Check out the full Job Description here: https://www.linkedin.com/jobs/view/4475930253/ Why join NIN? Work across diverse projects and visual styles, grow your skills alongside our Creative & Art Team, young creative professional environment, flexible Freelance / Part-time / Full-time opportunities, flexible working hours with Work From Home options. Ready to create with us? Send your CV + Portfolio via LinkedIn or email us at nincreativestudio@gmail.com Subject: Application – Illustrator Artist – [Your Name]

author: View Creative Agency
title: Senior Freelance Graphic Designer & Illustrator
content: SENIOR FREELANCE GRAPHIC DESIGNER & ILLUSTRATOR We’re expanding our creative network at View Creative and looking for experienced freelancers to work with us on a project-by-project basis. From branding and packaging to illustration and everyday design, you’ll bring strong ideas and the skills to make them happen. You’ll need: 5+ years’ professional experience, a strong creative and commercial portfolio, excellent Adobe Creative Suite skills, good working knowledge of Canva. Figma, animation and After Effects skills would be a bonus. Creative, reliable and commercially minded? We’d love to hear from you. Send your CV, portfolio and availability - DM us your details.

author: Baltic Analog Lab
title: Looking for Illustrator for Merch Artwork
content: We’re looking for a freelance graphic designer (preferably based in Latvia) for occasional collaborations, as well as an illustrator (national or international) to create fun artwork for our new merch! Send us a DM with your Instagram account or website. And if you know someone whose work you love, share your recommendations with us!
